name: @projexlight/sdk-policy
summary: Policy engine for ProjexCloud — declarative ABAC rules (attribute-based access control) that complement ReBAC for cases needing dynamic, attribute-driven decisions (time-of-day, geo, risk score, recent incidents). Policies authored in a small DSL, compiled to a fast evaluator, and called from every SDK that needs 'is this safe right now?' beyond simple relationship checks.

endpoints.description: Publish a new policy version (DSL source + compiled evaluator).
Fetch the latest version of a named policy + its evaluation history.
Evaluate a policy against an attribute bundle; returns allow/deny + which rule matched.
The active rules in force for a scope (optionally ?app_id=), most specific first. Tenant comes from the credential, never the query.

Up to 1000 evaluations in one request: ONE policy read per DISTINCT policy_id, one batched INSERT for the decision rows. An item naming an absent policy reports POLICY_NOT_FOUND in its own slot rather than 404-ing the request. NOTE: the audit fan-out is aggregated — one policy.evaluated-bulk.v1 per (batch, policy) carrying the allow/deny split, not one event per subject. Every individual decision is still written to policy.decision; use the single endpoint when per-subject audit events are required.

events.name: policy.published.v1
events.description: New policy version published; carries DSL hash + compiler version.

events.name: policy.decision.evaluated.v1
events.description: Per-evaluation row: which policy, which rule matched, decision, attributes fetched.

events.name: policy.attribute.fetched.v1
events.description: Attribute-fetcher run resolved a remote attribute; cached for the cache TTL.

models.description: Per-version row: name, version, dsl_source, compiled_blob, published_at, published_by.
Per-fetcher row: name, source (sql / http / sdk), config, cache_ttl_ms.
Per-evaluation audit row: policy, rule_matched, decision, attributes_snapshot, evaluated_at.

hooks.name: publishPolicy
hooks.description: Compile + publish a new policy version; idempotent on (name, version).

hooks.name: evaluatePolicy
hooks.description: Run the evaluator against an attribute bundle; returns decision + matched rule + evaluation trace.

hooks.name: registerFetcher
hooks.description: Register an attribute fetcher (e.g. 'fetch current risk_score from sdk-fraud').

hooks.name: startDecisionAuditor
hooks.description: Background worker: replays decisions periodically against the current policy + flags drift.

scenarios.title: Refuse admin actions outside business hours
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance ask: high-privilege actions only between 09:00-17:00 in the tenant's tz. Policy named 'admin-action-business-hours' fires when the resource attribute is_admin_action=true.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Policy compiled + persisted. Subsequent evaluatePolicy calls deny admin actions outside hours.

scenarios.title: Risk-score escalation triggers MFA step-up
scenarios.when_to_use: Adaptive auth — when risk_score is high, require MFA step-up before allowing privileged operations. The attribute fetcher pulls risk_score from sdk-fraud.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Decision = 'step-up' when risk_score crosses threshold. Audit chain has the matched rule + attribute snapshot for replay.

scenarios.title: Block exports of EU data outside the EU region
scenarios.when_to_use: Data-residency enforcement — outbound data transfer policy blocks EU-resident data leaving EU region pools, regardless of caller permissions.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Decision = 'deny'. Caller surfaces the policy's reason text to the operator. Audit row pins the policy + version that fired.

scenarios.title: Wire up the risk-score attribute fetcher
scenarios.when_to_use: One-time setup — fetcher caches risk-score lookups so adaptive-MFA policy can run on every request without DB hits.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Fetcher registered; subsequent evaluatePolicy calls auto-resolve risk_score on demand. Emits .attribute.fetched.v1 per refresh.

scenarios.title: Audit decisions against current policy
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance review — were past 24h decisions still valid under the current policy? The auditor replays them + flags drift.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Background pass replays decisions; drift > threshold pages the compliance oncall. Useful evidence for SOX + SOC2 control reviews.

compliance_posture.notes: Every decision pinned to the policy version + matched rule + attribute snapshot — fully reproducible for SOX + EU AI Act decision-transparency requirements. Default-deny posture (POLICY_DEFAULT_DECISION) means a misconfigured policy fails closed.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per evaluation (cached at the attribute layer)
